title: CLAIM: Leading Open-domain Active Clarification of Large Language Models with Uncertainty Measurement
abstract: arXiv:2608.11631v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In open-domain human-computer interaction scenarios, large language models (LLMs) frequently encounter user queries that are ambiguous or incomplete. In such cases, directly producing an answer often leads to overgeneralized, erroneous, or low-information responses. In contrast, asking clarifying questions can substantially improve interaction quality. However, existing approaches still rely heavily on manually annotated data or preference alignment to address two fundamental challenges: when clarification is necessary, and which aspect of the query should be clarified. This reliance incurs high annotation costs and limits generalization. To address these challenges, we propose CLAIM, an uncertainty-driven framework for active clarification learning in open-domain settings. translated_title: CLAIM：基于不确定性测量的开放域大语言模型主动澄清方法
translated_abstract: 在开放域人机交互场景中，大语言模型（LLMs）经常遇到模糊或不完整的用户查询。在这种情况下，直接生成答案往往会导致过度泛化、错误或低信息量的响应。相反，提出澄清问题可以显著提高交互质量。然而，现有方法仍严重依赖人工标注数据或偏好对齐来解决两个基本挑战：何时需要澄清，以及应澄清查询的哪个方面。这种依赖导致高昂的标注成本并限制泛化能力。为解决这些问题，我们提出CLAIM，一种用于开放域主动澄清学习的不确定性驱动框架。CLAIM通过量化由跨多个回答的分歧引起的熵来消除对显式人工偏好标注的需求。
tldr: CLAIM提出了一种无需人工标注、基于不确定性度量（答案分歧熵）的开放域主动澄清框架，能够自动决定何时澄清及澄清查询的哪个方面，从而提升交互质量。
en_tdlr: CLAIM proposes an uncertainty-driven framework that eliminates manual annotation by quantifying query ambiguity via answer-disagreement entropy, enabling automatic decisions on when and what to clarify in open-domain interactions.
